scope: LP2-A1: conditional LEFM/MTS continuation of the four accepted S4 matrix-confined paths with the unchanged LP1 numerics (4-mm step, protected p010 tip, 15-mm tip guide, unchanged mesher), S5 to at most S8 per case; per-case termination at the first non-MATRIX_ADVANCE classification or numerical HOLD
assignment: G2-LP2 consolidated assignment, 2026-11-25; predecessor PR #69 at d5f4681d851418d4386c2ddb21c7835f620fd9bf (review 6054335912 gives no LP2 GO)
g2SourceDefinition: sorted 'relative-path sha256' lines of every top-level matlab/g2/*.m and matlab/g2/vendor_p010_a14d8872/*.m, SHA-256 of the newline-joined UTF-8 string (same definition as the A1 source digest); LP2 code lives in matlab/g2/lp2/ and is pinned separately

parents.authority: A0 campaign G2-LP1-A0-001 (GO_A0, revoked after closure; 20/20 tier A, bitwise equal to run_20261122_lp1_v1)
parents.parentSIFFamily: A0/LP1 S4 (kinked_join p010 mesh family that the propagation recurrence was validated on); the A1 B9 refinement changes the S5 tip by about 1e-5 mm and is reported for comparison only, never used as a parent

ceilingJustification.meshQualification: unchanged LP1 mesher + g2_lp1_audit: S5 actual candidates 4/4; synthetic outlook polylines S6-S8 24/24 pass; S9 5/8, S10 4/8, beyond S12 almost always HOLD_LIP_STATIONS (unequal lip node counts per 4-mm segment at Hedge 0.45 mm); hence S8 is the last state inside the qualified mesher regime
ceilingJustification.geometry: hypothetical outlooks (not predictions): with the S4 MTS increment frozen, 7-8 further states remain admissible before the 15-mm tip guide of ring 1 binds; straight continuation, 15-16 states before ring 2; S8 is therefore well inside the geometric guards
ceilingJustification.resources: about 5-12 s mesh, 30 s audit and 2-3 s solve per state; 16 states take under 20 min; each state writes about 6 MB (under 0.1 GB in total)

physics: unchanged LP1: g2_lp1_audit (kink auditor 34 gates, T3 budget, bank adapter, four-mask phase audit, phase map) -> g2_m4b_ring_activation(case mask) -> g2_m4b_sif_partial with G2_TRAJECTORY_POLICY_v1 gates (16 criteria) -> g2_mts_direction (status OK, stationarity <= 1e-12)

constraintTypes: PHYSICAL_INTERFACE (guard tied to an active ring)
NUMERICAL_RING (guard tied to a passive ring contour)
classification.failureClasses: g2_lp2_failure_class: LOCAL (mesh, kink geometry, audit/phase of this mesh, solver, SIF gates, MTS root, actual-polygon clearance, classification) ends only that case with TERMINAL(NUMERICAL_HOLD); PREADMISSION_MEMORY and GLOBAL (source, policy, authorization, record/ledger integrity, memory after admission, unexpected) write a ledger HOLD that blocks the campaign, with no terminal and no closure; CAMPAIGN_REFUSAL writes nothing
classification.encounter: INTERFACE_ENCOUNTER is never assigned in LP2-A: a candidate segment that would violate an interface guard is an approach; the last accepted state and its remaining clearance are reported
classification.numericalHold: mesh, audit, SIF-gate, MTS, record, memory or campaign failures, and passive-ring guards; never physical arrest

authorization.resumption: none; a pre-admission memory HOLD needs a new investigator decision

stopRules: per case: stop at the first candidate that is not MATRIX_ADVANCE (terminal classification record, no mesh, no solve) or at the first HOLD (NUMERICAL_HOLD record, never retried)
per case: CAMPAIGN_LIMIT_REACHED after an accepted S8 (the S9 candidate is classified for information only)
the campaign closes when all four cases are terminal; at most 16 ADMIT entries; no resumption
no adaptive step, no change of mesher, guide, collar, q domains or gates; no interface penetration, interface propagation, CZM, debonding, arrest or branching

analysis.verifier: matlab/g2/lp2/g2_lp2_verify.m (read-only; every accepted state, terminal record and the ledger; inconsistency = integrity HOLD, never recomputation)
analysis.matching: all LP2-A1 states have identical arclengths s_k = 25.4 + 4k mm; own-path contrasts F_G(s) = G_X(s)/G_H(s) - 1 are compared ONLY at accepted arclengths common to both chains; inputs with unequal increments are rejected (G2LP2:ANALYSIS_UNSUPPORTED); interpolation in s belongs to a later work package and never matching by increment number
steering: signed lateral tip offset d(s) from the H polyline (positive towards the left normal of H)
minimum distance to each ring circle
analysis.distinction: own-path contrasts F_G(s) are not the direct material contribution of M5-X6 (fixed S4 crossed solves)

hypotheses.H1: the stiff13 shielding (F_G < 0) continues to increase in magnitude during propagation
hypotheses.H2: the soft2 shielding continues to weaken (|F_G| decreasing)
hypotheses.H3: the local MTS compensation observed at S4 persists away from the rings but changes as the crack approaches them
hypotheses.H4: material contrast changes whether the crack meets an active interface before another boundary

hypothesisRules.H1_H2: apply only while F_G < 0 at every LP2 point (s >= 41.4 mm): H1 SUPPORTED if F_G strictly decreases, H2 SUPPORTED if F_G strictly increases towards zero; CONTRADICTED if the last value moved against the hypothesis relative to the first; MIXED otherwise; a change of sign is SIGN_TRANSITION (shielding-to-amplification or the reverse), never continued strengthening/weakening; F_G > 0 throughout is NO_SHIELDING; fewer than two points is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
hypothesisRules.H3: DESCRIPTIVE_PROXY_ONLY: dMTS(s) = theta_X - theta_H reported with heading differences and lateral offsets; no material/path/interaction decomposition and no compensation claim from small local angle differences
hypothesisRules.H4: NOT_TESTABLE_WITHIN_LP2_A1: a numerical interface approach is not an encounter and a passive ring contour is not a material discontinuity; terminal tip, approached object, ring mask, clearance, terminating guard and ceiling truncation are reported descriptively

analysis.hypothesisStatus: open research questions; no tuning of the numerics or selection of architectures to confirm them; negative results preserved
analysis.fractureCriterion: conditional LEFM/MTS continuation at P = 1 N; no G_c, toughness or R-curve; no claim of physical propagation or arrest
